column3: “A great war” is rendered “one of great conflict.”
“Three sevens of days” is rendered “three entire weeks.”
“Food of desirableness” is rendered “tasty food”; “anoint I did not anoint” is rendered “nor did I use any ointment at all.”
“Side” is rendered “bank.”
NASB supplies “a belt of pure”; “one man” is rendered “a certain man.”
“Topaz” is rendered “beryl”; “a multitude” is rendered “a tumult.”
“Fled in hiding themselves” is rendered “ran away to hide themselves.”
“My vigor was changed on me into destruction” is rendered “my natural color turned to a deathly pallor.”
“I was dazed” is rendered “I fell into a deep sleep.”
“It shook me on my knees and the palms of my hands” is rendered “set me trembling on my hands and knees.”
“Man of preciousnesses” is rendered “man of high esteem”; “stand on your standing place” is rendered “stand upright.”
NASB adds “this”; “on your words” is rendered “in response to your words.”
“Standing before me” is rendered “withstanding me”; NASB renders “I remained behind there” as “I had been left there,” with “for.”
“The end of the days” is rendered “the latter days,” and “for the days” “for the days yet future.”
“Was dumb” is rendered “became speechless.”
“Like the likeness of the sons of humankind” is rendered “one who resembled a human being”; “they have turned my pangs on me” is rendered “anguish has come upon me.”
“This servant of my lord … this my lord” is rendered “such a servant … such as my lord.”
“Like the appearance of humankind” is rendered “this one with human appearance.”
“Be strong and be strong” is rendered “take courage and be courageous.”
“Do you know” is rendered “Do you understand.”
“Shows himself strong” is rendered “stands firmly”; NASB supplies “forces.”
